title: Lack of Price Freshness Verification in Oracle Price Data
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The `getOraclePrice` and `getCollateralExchangeInfo` functions retrieve `NodeOutput.Data` containing price information and a timestamp indicating the freshness of this price. An issue has been identified wherein these functions use the price data directly without verifying the freshness of the data based on the timestamp.
